name: State-Space Obfuscation via Parity/Majority Logic
description: Frame the independent set condition as a global energy balance equation $G = C$. The Total Capacity $C$ is the sum of degrees of selected modules, and the Total Gradient $G$ is the sum of absolute differences of states across conduits. Mathematically, $G \le C$ always holds, with equality occurring if and only if no two selected modules share a conduit. Models that fail to prove this mathematical equivalence will write a generic backtracking search that TLEs on $N=46$.
